COD.note: Programme is for young people, not civil servants.

facts.fact: The youth minister launched the operational phase of the national digital training programme for 250,000 young Congolese on 12 February 2026, with 200 trainers in session in Kinshasa from 12 to 15 February.

systems.owner: Ministry of Youth and Patriotic Awakening

COD.note: Cisco, Cybastion and Airtel are named as partners in a public-private programme, but no amount is stated.
